senses.gloss:
Paulacarita
metrical. on the life of Apostle Paul.
Pt.. with English, Bengali an. Hindi transl.. Bishop's College Press. Calcutta, 1850. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1909.

Paulastya
authority on śilpa. Q. in Dakṣiṇāmūrtipaṭala, C.. 22 of Śilpasaṅgraha, MD. 13058. MT. 5315.

Paulastya
--Śivastotra. SB. New D.. V. i. 18972.
C.. Śivatāṇḍavastotra ascribed to Rāvaṇa.

Paulastyatantra
(ºsam3hitā) pāñcarātra. listed in Pādmatantra, IO. 2532.
See also Panorama of Pāñcarātra Lit. p. 102.

Paulastyarāghavīya
kāvya. by Pullela Rāmacandra of Kauṇḍinyagotra. MT. 1700 (Bāla, Ayodhyā an. Āraṇya kāṇḍas) (14 sargas).
See Contribution of Andhra to Skt. Lit. p. 147.

Paulastyavadha
nāṭaka. by Lakṣmaṇa Sūri (1859-1919 A. D.).
Pt.. Oriental Press. Madras, 1914. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1909.

Paulastyasiddhānta
jy. Kavīndrācārya 859.
--C. Ibid.
C.. Pauliśasiddhānta below.

Paulastyasmṛti
Q. in Kālamādhavīya an. Madanapārijāta.
See Pulastyasmṛti. [Page204-b]

Pauliśamata
jy. Q. by Nṛsim3ha in C. on Sūryasiddhānta; Cambr. 43. Same a. next.

Pauliśasiddhānta
jy. Q. by Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa in C. Mārtaṇḍavallabhā on his Muhūrtamārtaṇḍa, BBRAS. 321; ref. to in Hillājajātaka, Alwar 605. Extr. 234; by Nṛsim3ha in Hillājadīpikā, Alwar 606. Extr. 234.
See also Puliśasiddhānta.

Paulomaparvan
4th upaparvan. Āvaṇapparambu Mana 91-92. Deśamaṅgalam 321. GD. 295. MT. 8239. Sucindram 10. 11. Whish 64.
See Kane, Vol. of Studies, Poona, 1941, p.. 351-55.
